contracts: The sidebar toggle/back/forward/reload header controls use RustActionView, a plain View host with no Button or ButtonController instance. Other control families retain their existing Button hosts; this is the first application of a shared action controller.

Rust ActionControl owns enabled/focused/on/visual state and pointer/key/gesture activation/cancellation. It reuses the existing RowPointer and platform Space/Return key policy. The view supplies native focus, mouse/capture/gesture/keyboard/window/AX events and invokes the existing browser command callback only for Rust Activate.

Header fields no longer store Button pointers. Metal consumes Rust snapshots through common glyph scene data; native fallback uses the same factored vector/icon painter as the comparison controls. A native FocusRing remains an explicit focus adapter, gated out of steady Metal paint as before.

Enabled-in-subtree changes cancel pending Rust input immediately. Blur, capture loss, control/widget hiding and widget removal also cancel; no members are accessed after a callback that may delete its host. Gesture cancel/end retain native unhandled propagation while canceling state.

The shared browser case verifies host identity, role/name/default-action metadata, physical Cocoa Space, Mac Return behavior, AX default activation/disabled rejection, tap/end and late release after hide/disable. Hidden-window reload must not reset a document marker. Existing actual navigation/history/reload/disable/sidebar-toggle/movement/focus/fallback/idle tests retain their assertions.

The common glyph data/painter refactor retains existing control behavior; the affected gate includes the dedicated Metal fixture and shared forms/editor/choice/viewport/window/split regressions. No dependency, browser service/store/admission/persistence policy change.

previous_full_checkpoint.scope: Earlier full pass predates resize and header action host migrations; it is not a full pass of this source.

remaining: Other action/button/row/control/node/container/menu/input/window ownership still requires migration. Native View identity and FocusRing remain adapters here; no complete Views removal or full functional parity claimed.
Manual hardware trackpad, IME candidates, VoiceOver, global RTL, scale/theme and GPU recovery remain open.
Current-main combined network policy and final shipped dependency/license/notice acceptance remain outside this frozen UI lab.

initial_probe.note: The existing header navigation case passed Metal. The new shared case exposed two corrections: native GestureEnd cancels visual state without handling the event, so Rust now preserves that propagation; hiding the parent also hides the sidebar child, so the hidden-action oracle now checks that reload leaves a document marker intact, rather than assuming child visibility. Original failing sources/logs retained.
